clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Ridge regression with 100×10-fold cross-validation predicted six psychopathology dimensions from PCA-reduced deviation features; nuisance covariates (age, sex) were regressed from outcomes within folds; exact tests and 100,000-permutation nulls assessed performance; case–control comparisons of deviations were performed for depression and ADHD.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Deviations improved out-of-sample prediction for overall psychopathology, positive psychosis, and fear versus raw volume. Regional deviations in vmPFC, inferior temporal, and daCC correlated more with overall psychopathology than specific dimensions. Case–control deviation effects overlapped and were reduced after controlling for overall psychopathology.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Across multiple scoring metrics (correlation, neg[RMSE], neg[MAE]), deviations yielded comparable or superior predictive performance to raw cortical volume, with significant gains for overall psychopathology and positive psychosis (and fear for MAE). No dimension showed raw volume outperforming deviations when deviations were non-significant. Regionally, deviations in vmPFC/mOFC, inferior temporal, and daCC related more strongly to overall psychopathology than dimension-specific scores. In case–control analyses (depression, ADHD), spatially overlapping deviation effects diminished when controlling for overall psychopathology, supporting shared disorder-general components.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Cross-sectional design; focus on T1-weighted cortical features; single-site sample; socioeconomic status and general intelligence may confound prediction.
caa10_key_limitations.supporting_text: "A limitation of this study is the use of cross-sectional data ... Another limitation is the focus on T1-weighted cortical brain features ..."; "this interpretation remains speculative, since our analysis was restricted to a single site"; "controlling for socioeconomic status and general intelligence ... resulted in many of our prediction models dropping below significance ..."

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Normative model trained on 281 healthy PNC participants; ROI-level cortical volume (Schaefer400 primary; Lausanne463 replication); deviations (per-ROI z-scores) used as features; prediction via ridge regression with rigorous cross-validation and permutation testing; extensive sensitivity analyses on nuisance covariates.
